definition: A context-dependent risk phenomenon or pattern concerning possible effects on value/objectives; distinct from records, descriptions, scores and workflow artifacts.
identity_rationale: Risk is the governed subject of risk discourse composed through relations among subject/context, scenario/event/consequence and assessment; forcing it into one UFO primitive would collapse competing legitimate views. Paper-1 continuity is governed by the stable semantic identity and the explicit #69 identity/continuity contract; mutable records, descriptions, assessment results, workflow/risk states, ownership and treatment history do not determine identity automatically.
diagram_instruction: Do not invent a derived-pattern/source stereotype; render explanatory pattern view linked to formal nodes.

definition: An entity, value-bearing object or externally owned item about which risk relevance is asserted.
identity_rationale: Entities of different externally owned kinds can contingently play the role of being the subject/object-at-risk in a risk context; the role supplies no identity principle.
diagram_instruction: Abstract cross-kind role; subtype identity supplied externally; explicit support relations still required in editable model.

definition: A risk-relevant origin, source or contextual contributor that may participate in a scenario or event; causal status is not implied by the label alone.
identity_rationale: A source may be an endurant, event or situation; one UFO class spanning those categories would be invalid. Source-ness is contextual and is expressed through source/causal relations.
diagram_instruction: Do not invent a derived-pattern/source stereotype; render explanatory pattern view linked to formal nodes.

definition: A contextual state-of-affairs or situational condition that increases susceptibility to a risk-relevant event/effect without necessarily directly causing it.
identity_rationale: A contextual state-of-affairs may obtain and increase susceptibility without being a causal event or intrinsic disposition.
diagram_instruction: Semantic category is not automatically an OntoUML stereotype.

definition: An occurrence acting as the initiating event for a risk-relevant event or process transition; an enabling condition is represented separately as a Predisposing Condition.
identity_rationale: For Paper-1 Core, a Trigger is an event/occurrence that contributes to the occurrence/transition of a Risk Event. Threshold triggers remain Method/Application semantics.
diagram_instruction: Semantic category is not automatically an OntoUML stereotype.

definition: A risk-relevant situation type specifying a possible configuration, whether or not instantiated; separate from the managed descriptions that express it and from realized events.
identity_rationale: Instances denote situation types, with explicit class facets subclassing gufo:Situation; no actual situation or event witness is required.
diagram_instruction: Identity decision implemented in rc.3; preserve helper generalizations and type levels in editable model. Serialization and visual validation remain separate.

definition: A realized occurrence relevant to a risk context, distinct from a possible scenario and information artifacts describing it.
identity_rationale: A realized occurrence has temporal parts/boundaries and participates in causal chains; identity is occurrence-based.
diagram_instruction: Semantic category is not automatically an OntoUML stereotype.

definition: A risk-relevant outcome or effect of an event/scenario; its magnitude/severity may be assessed separately.
identity_rationale: Core Consequence is the resulting state-of-affairs/effect after an event/scenario; an event-like consequence may be a profile refinement.
diagram_instruction: Semantic category is not automatically an OntoUML stereotype.

definition: A disposition or condition that increases susceptibility to a risk-relevant event/effect.
identity_rationale: A vulnerability existentially depends on its bearer and can manifest in risk events; its identity is that of an intrinsic disposition, not a contextual situation.
diagram_instruction: Semantic category is not automatically an OntoUML stereotype.

definition: A context-dependent condition or relation indicating how a subject/value is exposed to a risk-relevant source/event; assessment scores remain separate.
identity_rationale: Exposure is a relational state-of-affairs involving a subject and source/context; exposure ratings/amounts are separate assessment/method values.
diagram_instruction: Semantic category is not automatically an OntoUML stereotype.

definition: An activity applying a method, context and evidence to produce one or more risk assessment results.
identity_rationale: Assessment is an occurrence performed by an actor/system over time and historically produces a result.
diagram_instruction: Semantic category is not automatically an OntoUML stereotype.

definition: A persistent mechanism, capability or implemented measure used in prevention, detection, protection or risk treatment.
identity_rationale: Different bearer kinds can contingently function as controls. The controlling capability is intrinsic to a bearer, while 'being used as a control' is contextual.
diagram_instruction: Abstract cross-kind role; subtype identity supplied externally; explicit support relations still required in editable model.

definition: A context-dependent role classification of persons, organizations or other eligible external actors bearing specified risk-management responsibilities; bearer identity is supplied by the external actor kinds, not by ownership.
identity_rationale: Persons and organizations can bear responsibility under different external identity principles; a universal sortal Role is not justified.
diagram_instruction: Abstract cross-kind role; subtype identity supplied externally; explicit support relations still required in editable model.

definition: A concrete responsibility/accountability assignment context that depends on an Actor/role bearer and any modeled governance participants, and is about the Risk, artifact, plan or obligation it concerns.
identity_rationale: A concrete normative assignment/relator context depends on the Actor/role bearer and any explicitly modeled endurant governance participants; it carries validity/history and is about the Risk/artifact/obligation it concerns. The derived Risk pattern is not forced to be a mediated endurant.
diagram_instruction: At least two distinct endurant participants; Risk is aboutness target. Opt-in named-witness shape is implemented.

definition: A governed information artifact organizing risk register entries for a defined scope; its managed identity persists as entries are added or removed.

diagram_instruction: Semantic category is not automatically an OntoUML stereotype.

definition: An externally owned enterprise/governance objective that may be affected by or provide context for risk.
